description_en: Queries the top 10 protected objects that triggered protection rules most frequently
description_zh: 查看触发防护规则次数最多的前10个防护对象
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-rule-hits-top-resource --start-timestamp 1665331200 --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRuleHitsTopResource

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询的开始时间，单位：秒
parameters.name: start_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used as the end time
parameters.help_zh: 查询的结束时间，单位：秒。如果不设置该参数，结束时间为当前的查询时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en:
The type of rule that was triggered. If you do not specify this parameter, data for all rule types is returned.

blacklist: The IP address blacklist.

custom: A custom rule.

antiscan: A scan protection rule.

cc_system: An HTTP flood protection rule.

region_block: The Location Blacklist feature
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象命中的规则类型。默认不设置该参数，表示显示全部规则。

blacklist: 表示命中IP黑名单。

custom：表示命中自定义规则。

antiscan: 表示命中扫描防护规则。

cc_system:  表示命中CC防护规则。

region_block: 表示区域封禁
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

RuleHitsTopResource.description_en: The top 10 protected objects that triggered protection rules
RuleHitsTopResource.description_zh: 防护对象的规则命中情况Top10

items.description_en: The details of a protected object that triggered a protection rule
items.description_zh: 防护对象的规则命中情况
